fields.name: supports_streaming_events
fields.description: Whether the executor emits progressive stream events

fields.name: supports_task_cancellation
fields.description: Whether running tasks can be cancelled cooperatively or preemptively

fields.name: supports_task_resume
fields.description: Whether suspended or waiting tasks can be resumed with input

fields.name: supports_structured_result
fields.description: Whether structured json data payloads can be returned

fields.name: supported_canonical_roles
fields.description: Canonical roles supported by this executor (e.g. 'planner', 'coder', 'reviewer', 'steward', 'executor')

fields.name: supports_working_directory
fields.description: Whether tasks can be dispatched to an explicit working directory

fields.name: supports_artifact_transport
fields.description: Whether input and output file artifacts are tracked and transported

fields.name: max_timeout_seconds
fields.description: Maximum allowed execution timeout in seconds if constrained

fields.name: concurrency_limit
fields.description: Maximum concurrent tasks allowed by adapter instance
